prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'm not comfortable giving my full name on a recording without knowing how it will be used.

Q: That's understandable. This recording is for the claim file only. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the right lane on the main road in Baytown, Texas, heading toward the interchange.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the left because the lane ahead was slowing down. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to move over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?
A: I believe so. I clicked it on before I started moving.

Q: Where was the other vehicle when you first noticed it?
A: I didn't notice it until we made contact. It came up on my left side, and then there was a loud scrape and my car pushed sideways.

Q: Did either vehicle stop after the collision?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we exchanged information.

Q: How are you feeling physically right now?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a long time. I went to urgent care that same day.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: I had some mild back soreness a few years ago, but nothing that required treatment or time off work.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm trying to keep up with my physical therapy and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
